topic: Universal Gravitation, Kepler's Laws & Orbital Mechanics
title: Grade 9 Olympiad Universal Gravitation & Orbital Mechanics Conceptual Ontology & Dependency Graph

structural_pillars.name: Newton's Universal Gravitation & Central Force Invariant
structural_pillars.statement: Every point mass in the universe attracts every other point mass with a force along the line intersecting them, proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of their separation distance. Gravitational force is strictly conservative and central.
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Holds for point particles and spherically symmetric mass distributions in non-relativistic regimes (v << c, weak gravitational potentials).

structural_pillars.name: Newton's Shell Theorem & Interior Solid Sphere Linear Scaling
structural_pillars.statement: A uniform spherical shell of matter exerts no net gravitational force on any particle located inside it. Outside the shell, it exerts the exact gravitational force as if its entire mass were concentrated at its center. Consequently, inside a uniform solid sphere of radius R, gravitational field scales strictly linearly with distance r from the center.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: g(r) = \begin{cases} \frac{G M}{R^3} r, & r \le R \\ \frac{G M}{r^2}, & r \ge R \end{cases}, \quad g_{\text{cavity}} \equiv 0
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Requires strict spherically symmetric density distribution rho(r).

structural_pillars.name: Gravitational Potential Field & Universal Datum at Infinity
structural_pillars.statement: Gravitational potential energy is defined as the work done by an external agent against the gravitational field to bring masses from infinite separation to separation r. By establishing the universal datum U(infinity) = 0, gravitational potential energy is strictly negative for all finite bound configurations.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: U(r) = -\int_{\infty}^r \vec{F}_g \cdot d\vec{r} = -\frac{G M m}{r}, \quad V(r) = -\frac{G M}{r}, \quad \vec{g} = -\vec{\nabla} V
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Applies to localized, asymptotically flat mass distributions where U vanishes at infinity.

structural_pillars.name: Kepler's Laws & Angular Momentum Conservation
structural_pillars.statement: Because gravity is a strictly central force, the net torque about the primary center of mass is identically zero. Therefore, orbital angular momentum is conserved, ensuring planar motion and constant areal velocity (Kepler's Second Law). Planetary orbits are ellipses with the primary mass at one focus (Kepler's First Law), and orbital periods satisfy T^2 proportional to a^3 (Kepler's Third Law).
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Valid for two-body Keplerian systems dominated by a central mass M >> m.

structural_pillars.name: Orbital Energy Partition, Virial Theorem & Escape Velocity
structural_pillars.statement: For any bound circular Keplerian orbit of radius r, kinetic energy equals exactly half the magnitude of the potential energy, and total mechanical energy is negative. Escape velocity from a gravitational well is the minimum speed required to achieve zero total mechanical energy (parabolic trajectory reaching infinity with zero residual kinetic energy).
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Applies to inverse-square central force fields; E < 0 defines bound elliptical orbits, E = 0 defines parabolic escape, and E > 0 defines hyperbolic flybys.

nodes.description: Equivalence principle equating resistance to acceleration with source of gravitational attraction.
Idealization of macroscopic bodies as spatial points separated by scalar distance r.
Dimensional coupling constant G = 6.674 x 10^-11 N m^2 / kg^2.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Astronauts float weightlessly aboard the International Space Station because there is no gravity in space.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Earth's gravitational field at the ISS orbital altitude of 400 km is approximately 8.8 m/s^2, which is nearly 90% of sea-level gravity. Astronauts float because the station and everything inside it are in perpetual free-fall together toward Earth, so the normal contact support force vanishes (apparent weightlessness: N = 0).
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Calculating g_orbit = g_surface * [R_E / (R_E + h)]^2: with R_E = 6400 km and h = 400 km, g = 9.8 * (6400 / 6800)^2 = 8.68 m/s^2. A stationary tower at 400 km height would weigh astronauts at 89% of their sea-level weight.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: As one descends down a deep mine shaft toward Earth's center, r decreases, so gravitational force must increase to infinity according to 1/r^2.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: By Newton's Shell Theorem, all spherical layers of Earth above the observer exert zero net gravitational force. Only the sphere of mass enclosed within current radius r exerts attraction: M_enc(r) = M_E * (r/R_E)^3. Therefore, g(r) = G * M_enc / r^2 = (G M_E / R_E^3) * r, which decreases strictly linearly to exactly zero at Earth's center.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Gravimeter readings inside deep boreholes (e.g. Kola Superdeep Borehole) confirm that gravity decreases below the crustal boundary, and symmetry dictates that at the geometric center r = 0, symmetric pulls from all directions cancel out identically to 0.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: If a rocket reaches circular orbital speed, it has achieved escape velocity and can travel freely to other planets.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Circular orbital speed v_orb = sqrt(GM/r) provides just enough kinetic energy to continuously fall around the planet in a closed, bound elliptical path with total energy E = -GMm / (2r) < 0. Escape velocity v_esc = sqrt(2GM/r) = sqrt(2) * v_orb is 41.4% higher, providing the threshold energy E = 0 to break the gravitational bond entirely and reach infinity.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Orbital satellites fired at v_orb remain trapped in low Earth orbit for decades; the Apollo lunar missions had to perform Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI) to accelerate from 7.8 km/s to nearly 11 km/s to climb out of Earth's deep potential well.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Planets travel at constant linear speed along their elliptical orbital trajectories.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Because gravity is a central force, orbital angular momentum L = m * r * v_perp is conserved. Consequently, linear speed varies inversely with radial distance: linear speed is strictly maximum at closest approach (perihelion) and minimum at farthest distance (aphelion): r_p * v_p = r_a * v_a.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Observational astronomy of Halley's Comet: at perihelion (0.59 AU), it races at 54.6 km/s; at aphelion (35.1 AU), it crawls at just 0.91 km/s. The ratio of speeds exactly matches the inverse ratio of orbital distances.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: The Moon attracts water only on the near side of Earth, so the oceans should have only one high tide per day.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Tides are caused by the differential gravitational gradient dg/dr = -2GM/r^3 across Earth's diameter. The Moon pulls near-side water toward it more than solid Earth, creating the near-side bulge; it also pulls solid Earth toward it more than far-side water, leaving the far-side water behind to create an identical second bulge on the opposite side.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Global coastal tide gauges record two high tides and two low tides approximately every 24 hours and 50 minutes (semidiurnal tidal cycle).

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: An astronaut's mass decreases by a factor of 6 when traveling to the Moon.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Mass is an invariant intrinsic scalar quantifying matter and inertia; it is identical everywhere in the universe. Weight is the local gravitational force W = m * g. On the Moon, g_moon approx 1.62 m/s^2 (one-sixth of Earth's), so the astronaut's weight is reduced to 1/6, while their mass m is unchanged.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: An astronaut on the Moon trying to kick a 100 kg rock horizontally finds it just as difficult to accelerate (F = ma) as on Earth, despite its scale weight reading only 16.7 kg-equivalent.
